meta.name: Would You Marry Me
meta.description: A couple who pretend to be newlyweds, find themselves developing genuine feelings for each other as they navigate their fake marriage.

videos.title: Episode 1
videos.overview: Meri loses everything to betrayal and fraud, then wins a luxury townhouse in a prize event.

videos.title: Episode 2
videos.overview: Wooju rejects Meri's request to act as her husband, but fate soon brings them together again.

videos.title: Episode 3
videos.overview: Wooju walks drunk Meri home from a work dinner. Later, he hears her scream and rushes in.

videos.title: Episode 4
videos.overview: Ahead of the department store president's visit, Meri and Wooju grow closer posing as newlyweds.

videos.title: Episode 5
videos.overview: Meri's ex calls and unsettles her, but she hides it as she starts a new project with Myungsoondang.

videos.title: Episode 6
videos.overview: After a tense rooftop moment, Meri and Wooju grow closer. Meri fears her ex may learn their secret.

videos.title: Episode 7
videos.overview: Sheltering from a storm, Meri and Wooju spend the night at Beauté Palace, where a surprise awaits.

videos.title: Episode 8
videos.overview: Meri and Wooju share past wounds and embrace their love, yet shadows of doubt and danger lie ahead.

videos.title: Episode 9
videos.overview: Meri makes a decision to protect Wooju. Meanwhile, Wooju investigates a hidden secret at work.

videos.title: Episode 10
videos.overview: Sanghyeon learns about Meri and Wooju. Meanwhile, Wooju follows a trail that reveals a major secret.

videos.title: Episode 11
videos.overview: Wooju uncovers the truth from 25 years ago and faces the one who started it all.

videos.title: Episode 12
videos.overview: Wooju and Meri are thrown into crisis again when Meri's ex calls an emergency press conference.

meta.slogan: A fake marriage, a true romance.
